decisions.reason: The JLCPCB order check does not change the existing component-sourceability or Extended-part fee policies; it only adds an order-setup validation task.
Submitting the completed boards to JLCPCB for an issue check does not change the BOM's required contents or any current BOM entry.
The manufacturer order check does not establish or modify KiCad project portability.
The source refers to checking completed files through JLCPCB but does not change the required production-file set or target board.
The order-setup check does not alter any interboard connector, pinout, or power-distribution requirement.
The source does not modify the AXP2101 power-path topology or operating constraints.
The JLCPCB ordering check does not change the LED supply voltage, data drive, or level-shifter decision.
The source does not change the LED standby cutoff behavior, GPIO control, or MOSFET switching topology.
The manufacturing order check has no entailed effect on the BOOT or reset circuit requirements.
The source does not alter the selected ESP32 module, breakout access, hole placement, or pitch.
The source adds a manufacturer ordering check but establishes no change to GPIO assignments or compatibility constraints.
The order-setup validation applies to completed boards generally but does not modify the LED board's role, LED count, or selected component.
